description: As a lifelong educator, Cassandra Mayes believes it's time to begin an honest community conversation about whether Maumelle should have its own school district. During a recent interview with KTHV, she discussed how local control could give parents, educators, and residents a stronger voice in the decisions that shape our schools and our children's future. Watch the interview:KTHV Interview - Cassandra.mov
